reply.text: I need to check what's on your program and what you've got scheduled before we make a swap. You're not running a program right now, so there's nothing to swap in the system. If you want to build something for a bit with lighter back work, I can do that — just tell me what days you've got to train this week and what else you want to hit besides backs. But first: is this a sharp pain, stiffness, or something else going on? If it's real pain, that's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach.
